highlights: Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – BEAT; EBITDA - BEAT Changes in Estimates post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: -3%/-5%; EBITDA: -4%/-7%; PAT: -11%/-17% Recommendation Rationale • Gradual Recovery Gains Traction: VIP Industries reported ~15.2% YoY revenue growth in Q2FY27, sustaining the momentum for the second consecutive quarter.
Growth was supported by over 50 product launches in H1FY27 across VIP, Skybags and Aristocrat, contributing 45% of hard luggage and backpack sales.
Gross margin expanded 1,606 bps YoY to 46.7%, supported by portfolio premiumisation and price hikes, which helped offset raw material inflation.

Going ahead, the company remains focused on sustaining double-digit growth and achieving break- even through higher ASPs, continued pricing actions, cost-control initiatives and fixed-cost optimisation.
valuation: Result Update 13th November, 2026 HOLD Target Price 265 VIP Industries Ltd Consumer Discretionary - Luggage 1 Recovery Gains Momentum; Maintain HOLD Est.

Sector Outlook: Cautious Company Outlook & Guidance: VIP Industries continues to target double-digit growth, driven by a dual strategy of price hikes and premiumisation, alongside cost-control initiatives to improve profitability.
However, given the gradual pace of recovery, we maintain our HOLD rating on the stock with a revised TP of Rs 265/share, indicating an upside of 7% from the CMP.
